# Targets and toolchains

**Audience:** integrators and compiler contributors<br>
**Status:** current reference<br>
**Audited:** `8b8cb19`<br>
**Evidence:** `selfhost/src/edva.dva`, `std/target/`, `examples/thumbv6m-none-eabi/`

The compiler emits LLVM IR and uses `clang` for assembly and linking. The host
needs system `libLLVM-18`; the selected target also needs a suitable clang,
linker, C library, and startup objects where applicable.

```sh
./edva program.dva -target aarch64-linux-gnu
./edva program.dva -ir -target thumbv6m-none-eabi -no-runtime
```

Use `-ir` to separate Edva lowering from the external toolchain. It writes a
`.ll` file without running clang. `-no-runtime` omits the hosted runtime and is
appropriate only when the target supplies required startup and platform code.

The repository contains target support and an example for
`thumbv6m-none-eabi`. Treat it as a platform-specific integration example,
including its linker script and register definitions, rather than a portable
hosted-program template.
